fact: Under the Central Bank law (arts. 216-220), entities licensed by the CBE including banks and payment and finance companies are subject to a customer-rights regime, with a CBE customer rights unit that examines complaints within 30 days and a dispute committee that rules within 60 days.
title: حماية حقوق العملاء في البنك وفقًا لقانون البنك المركزي المصري
